package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	teacherContextRecentTail             = 12
	teacherContextMinimumCompactMessages = 8
)

var teacherContextSummaryNamespace = uuid.MustParse("f39ddf30-e4d2-5bc4-9c4f-514b67c3b8ed")

// ContextBuilder compacts only Dialog-provided public message excerpts. A
// summary is optional and provisional; the exact current source always stays
// in the response context and raw history remains owned by Dialog.
type ContextBuilder struct {
	Summaries  repository.TeacherContextSummaryRepository
	Summarizer repository.TeacherContextSummarizer
}

func (builder ContextBuilder) Build(
	ctx context.Context,
	dialog domain.DialogRequestContext,
	languageCode string,
	now time.Time,
) (domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewDialogRequestContext(dialog)
	if err != nil || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	source := normalized.Messages[len(normalized.Messages)-1]
	if utf8.RuneCountInString(source.Body) > domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes {
		return domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, domain.ErrTeacherContextSourceTooLarge
	}
	scope, err := domain.NewTeacherContextScope(domain.TeacherContextScope{
		StudentID: normalized.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: normalized.PersonalTeacherID,
		DialogID: normalized.DialogID, ContextType: normalized.ContextType, ContextID: normalized.ContextID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, err
	}

	var latest *domain.TeacherContextSummary
	if builder.Summaries != nil {
		if stored, found, latestErr := builder.Summaries.Latest(ctx, scope); latestErr == nil && found {
			if summary, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummary(stored); normalizeErr == nil &&
				summary.CoveredThroughSequence < source.MessageSequence {
				latest = &summary
			}
		}
	}
	if latest != nil && digestRangeVisible(normalized.Messages, *latest) {
		visible := messagesInSequenceRange(normalized.Messages, latest.DigestFromSequence, latest.DigestThroughSequence)
		if digestDialogMessages(visible) != latest.SourceDigest {
			if builder.Summaries != nil {
				if _, invalidateErr := builder.Summaries.Invalidate(ctx, scope, latest.CoveredThroughSequence, now.UTC()); invalidateErr != nil {
					return domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, invalidateErr
				}
			}
			latest = nil
		}
	}

	active := activeContextMessages(normalized.Messages)
	if builder.Summarizer != nil && builder.Summaries != nil {
		if compacted := builder.compact(ctx, scope, languageCode, active, normalized.Messages, latest, now.UTC()); compacted != nil {
			latest = compacted
		}
	}

	through := int64(0)
	if latest != nil {
		through = latest.CoveredThroughSequence
	}
	window := boundedRecentMessages(activeAfter(active, through))
	result := domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{Messages: window}
	if latest != nil {
		result.ProvisionalSummary = summaryProjection(*latest)
	}
	result = fitPromptContext(result)
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherPromptDialogContext(result, normalized.SourceMessageID, normalized)
}

func (builder ContextBuilder) compact(
	ctx context.Context,
	scope domain.TeacherContextScope,
	languageCode string,
	active []domain.DialogMessage,
	visible []domain.DialogMessage,
	latest *domain.TeacherContextSummary,
	now time.Time,
) *domain.TeacherContextSummary {
	previousThrough := int64(0)
	if latest != nil {
		previousThrough = latest.CoveredThroughSequence
	}
	unsummarized := activeAfter(active, previousThrough)
	if len(unsummarized) < teacherContextRecentTail+teacherContextMinimumCompactMessages {
		return nil
	}
	maximumPrefix := len(unsummarized) - teacherContextRecentTail
	prefix := make([]domain.DialogMessage, 0, maximumPrefix)
	var excerptBytes int
	for _, message := range unsummarized[:maximumPrefix] {
		excerpt := excerptMessage(message)
		if excerptBytes+len(excerpt.Body) > domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes {
			break
		}
		excerptBytes += len(excerpt.Body)
		prefix = append(prefix, message)
	}
	if len(prefix) < teacherContextMinimumCompactMessages {
		return nil
	}
	requestMessages := make([]domain.TeacherContextMessage, 0, len(prefix))
	for _, message := range prefix {
		requestMessages = append(requestMessages, excerptMessage(message))
	}
	through := prefix[len(prefix)-1].MessageSequence
	request := domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: summaryIdempotencyKey(scope, through), LanguageCode: languageCode,
		Scope: scope, Messages: requestMessages,
	}
	if latest != nil {
		prior := latest.Payload
		request.PriorSummary = &prior
	}
	request, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummarizationRequest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	payload, err := builder.Summarizer.Summarize(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	payload, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	coveredFrom := prefix[0].MessageSequence
	createdAt := now
	if latest != nil {
		coveredFrom = latest.CoveredFromSequence
		createdAt = latest.CreatedAt
	}
	digestFrom := prefix[0].MessageSequence
	digestMessages := prefix
	if rangeEndpointsVisible(visible, coveredFrom, through) {
		digestFrom = coveredFrom
		digestMessages = messagesInSequenceRange(visible, coveredFrom, through)
	}
	candidate := domain.TeacherContextSummary{
		Scope: scope, CoveredFromSequence: coveredFrom, CoveredThroughSequence: through,
		DigestFromSequence: digestFrom, DigestThroughSequence: through,
		DigestEventSequence: maximumDialogEventSequence(digestMessages),
		SourceDigest:        digestDialogMessages(digestMessages), Payload: payload,
		SchemaCode: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion,
		CreatedAt: createdAt, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	stored, _, err := builder.Summaries.Store(ctx, domain.TeacherContextSummaryUpdate{
		Summary: candidate, ExpectedThroughSequence: previousThrough, NewFromSequence: prefix[0].MessageSequence,
	})
	if err == nil {
		return &stored
	}
	// A concurrent worker may have advanced the same scope. Use only a result
	// that won durable CAS; never substitute the unpersisted model output.
	if current, found, latestErr := builder.Summaries.Latest(ctx, scope); latestErr == nil && found {
		if normalized, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummary(current); normalizeErr == nil &&
			normalized.CoveredThroughSequence < active[len(active)-1].MessageSequence {
			return &normalized
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func activeContextMessages(messages []domain.DialogMessage) []domain.DialogMessage {
	result := make([]domain.DialogMessage, 0, len(messages))
	for _, message := range messages {
		if message.Status == 1 && strings.TrimSpace(message.Body) != "" {
			result = append(result, message)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func activeAfter(messages []domain.DialogMessage, through int64) []domain.DialogMessage {
	result := make([]domain.DialogMessage, 0, len(messages))
	for _, message := range messages {
		if message.MessageSequence > through {
			result = append(result, message)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func excerptMessage(message domain.DialogMessage) domain.TeacherContextMessage {
	body := message.Body
	runes := []rune(body)
	if len(runes) > domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes {
		body = string(runes[:domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes])
	}
	return domain.TeacherContextMessage{
		AuthorType: message.AuthorType, Body: body, MessageSequence: message.MessageSequence,
	}
}

func boundedRecentMessages(messages []domain.DialogMessage) []domain.TeacherContextMessage {
	start := 0
	if len(messages) > domain.TeacherContextMaximumMessages {
		start = len(messages) - domain.TeacherContextMaximumMessages
	}
	result := make([]domain.TeacherContextMessage, 0, len(messages)-start)
	totalBytes := 0
	for index := start; index < len(messages); index++ {
		excerpt := excerptMessage(messages[index])
		totalBytes += len(excerpt.Body)
		result = append(result, excerpt)
	}
	for totalBytes > domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes && len(result) > 1 {
		totalBytes -= len(result[0].Body)
		result = result[1:]
	}
	if len(result) > 0 {
		result[len(result)-1].IsSource = true
	}
	return result
}

func fitPromptContext(input domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext) domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext {
	for len(input.Messages) > 1 {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(input)
		if err == nil && len(encoded) <= domain.TeacherContextMaximumBytes && utf8.RuneCount(encoded) <= domain.TeacherContextMaximumRunes {
			return input
		}
		input.Messages = input.Messages[1:]
	}
	return input
}

func summaryProjection(summary domain.TeacherContextSummary) *domain.TeacherContextSummaryProjection {
	return &domain.TeacherContextSummaryProjection{
		Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, PolicyVersion: summary.PolicyVersion,
		CoveredFromSequence: summary.CoveredFromSequence, CoveredThroughSequence: summary.CoveredThroughSequence,
		Observations: summary.Payload,
	}
}

func summaryIdempotencyKey(scope domain.TeacherContextScope, through int64) string {
	identity := strings.Join([]string{
		scope.StudentID, scope.PersonalTeacherID, scope.DialogID, string(scope.ContextType), scope.ContextID,
		jsonNumber(through),
	}, "\x1f")
	return uuid.NewSHA1(teacherContextSummaryNamespace, []byte(identity)).String()
}

func digestRangeVisible(messages []domain.DialogMessage, summary domain.TeacherContextSummary) bool {
	return rangeEndpointsVisible(messages, summary.DigestFromSequence, summary.DigestThroughSequence)
}

func rangeEndpointsVisible(messages []domain.DialogMessage, from, through int64) bool {
	foundFrom, foundThrough := false, false
	for _, message := range messages {
		foundFrom = foundFrom || message.MessageSequence == from
		foundThrough = foundThrough || message.MessageSequence == through
	}
	return foundFrom && foundThrough
}

func messagesInSequenceRange(messages []domain.DialogMessage, from, through int64) []domain.DialogMessage {
	result := make([]domain.DialogMessage, 0)
	for _, message := range messages {
		if message.MessageSequence >= from && message.MessageSequence <= through {
			result = append(result, message)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func digestDialogMessages(messages []domain.DialogMessage) string {
	type digestMessage struct {
		ID                string                         `json:"id"`
		AuthorType        domain.DialogMessageAuthorType `json:"author_type"`
		Body              string                         `json:"body"`
		Status            int                            `json:"status"`
		MessageSequence   int64                          `json:"message_sequence"`
		LastEventSequence int64                          `json:"last_event_sequence"`
	}
	values := make([]digestMessage, 0, len(messages))
	for _, message := range messages {
		values = append(values, digestMessage{
			ID: message.ID, AuthorType: message.AuthorType, Body: message.Body, Status: message.Status,
			MessageSequence: message.MessageSequence, LastEventSequence: message.LastEventSequence,
		})
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(values)
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func maximumDialogEventSequence(messages []domain.DialogMessage) int64 {
	maximum := int64(0)
	for _, message := range messages {
		if message.LastEventSequence > maximum {
			maximum = message.LastEventSequence
		}
	}
	return maximum
}

func jsonNumber(value int64) string {
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(value)
	return string(encoded)
}
